qa.title: Q2303 (Aug. 7, 2026)
qa.question: I attack the enemy leader with a 5-attack follower with this equipped. If they play Realm of Repose's activated ability at Quick timing, how much damage does the enemy leader take?
qa.answer:
The enemy leader would take either 4 damage or 6 damage, depending on the opponent's decision.

When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player receiving the damage decides the order in which the abilities are applied. In this case, depending on the order, the final damage taken can be calculated either of the following two ways:

1. The opponent chooses to apply the +2 damage first. In this case, Realm of Repose's ability would reduce the incoming 7 damage to 4.

2. The opponent chooses to apply Realm of Repose's ability first. In this case, it would reduce the incoming 5 damage to 4, which would then be modified to 6.

Your leader would take 3 damage.

When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player receiving the damage decides the order in which the abilities are applied. However, in this case, all orders would result in the same damage calculation.

qa.title: Q2301 (Aug. 7, 2026)
qa.question: I have a Shion, Immortal Aegis on the field. How much damage does it take if it is attacked by a 1-attack enemy follower with this equipped?
qa.answer:
It would take either 0 damage or 2 damage, depending on your decision.

When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player who controls the follower receiving the damage decides the order in which the abilities are applied. In this case, depending on the order, the final damage taken can be calculated either of the following two ways:

1. Shion, Immortal Aegis takes 0 damage because you decide to apply its ability first, reducing 1 damage to 0. Then, since taking 0 damage doesn't count as taking damage at all, there is no instance of damage that would be modified by +2.

2. Shion, Immortal Aegis takes 2 damage because you decide to apply the +2 damage first, modifying the damage taken to 3, which is then reduced to 2 by Shion, Immortal Aegis's ability.
